feature: Decode-owned PD DSpark accepted-path capture and target-KV draft context reconstruction from received target prefix

environment.transport: Actual Mooncake TransferEngine TCP plus independent TCP Store segment/reader
environment.dependency_adjustment: Removed only the temporary container's preinstalled flashinfer-cubin/flashinfer-jit-cache 0.6.12; the shared venv and resident environment were unchanged.

implementation: D selects pd_speculative_accepted_target_path and the PD-aware cohort coordinator. P sends the first raw teacher row; D captures its real accepted verify path and trims to final EOS/length.

BaseSpecWorker exposes disaggregation_draft_kv_pool. Target-KV DSpark returns no draft transfer pool, allowing an AR-only P and reconstructing D's draft context from received target KV before proposals.
Target-KV P skips legacy hidden-input pruning and prefix projection. Hidden-input drafts retain their existing P-side projected draft-KV transfer.
The PD capture gate allows DSpark while retaining PP=1, DP/CP restrictions, Mooncake-only transport and no optimistic prefill.
Test-only source observers read P canonical KV at transfer, including early prefix sends before capture admission; raw logits remain observed before sampling mutations.

failed_attempts.reason: Fixture enabled decode radix cache with speculation; existing serving validation rejects that combination. Fixture now retains P radix and uses D chunk cache.
Forward-time P KV reference was captured before radix insertion replaced a recomputed prompt row. Observe canonical slots at actual P sends instead.
Transfer observer initially required a P capture context and omitted early cached-prefix sends before P admission. Observe every send and filter by published trace ID.

infrastructure_failed_attempt.cause: northjob kept the -- separator in the shell command, producing -- sleep 7200. Recreated with explicit shared workspace and sleep 7200 without the separator after confirming terminal state.

invariants: Selected KV and raw top-128 logits/IDs are exactly equal to independent online observations; full-vocabulary LSE uses rtol=atol=1e-6.
Tokens, positions, prompt=0/response=1 loss mask, KV validity and accepted-path terminal boundaries match final responses.
D source frames for selected speculative requests are all verify frames; no target prefill is added to obtain training data.
Cases include a one-token response, a 153-token chunked prompt, cached prefix reuse, rejected/full acceptance and an actual two-request decode batch.
Missing/stale handoffs and streamed cancellations do not publish snapshots; serving survives and capture work drains with zero quarantined Host slots.
Target-KV observations validate rebuilding a complete received prefix and incremental projection; graph cases execute real target verify CUDA graphs.
Ragged tests require unequal verification budgets and cap trimming; compact graph additionally requires padding and folded acceptance.
limitations: Synthetic untrained drafts and controlled proposals validate mechanics, not training quality, useful acceptance rate or throughput.
PD speculative D uses chunk cache because core serving rejects decode radix cache with speculation; P retains radix prefix reuse.
Target-KV v1 remains static verify. Confidence-scheduled cap-accept/compact applies to legacy hidden-input drafts.
Real speculative PD coverage is PP1, TP1/TP2 on Qwen3-0.6B. This does not certify pipeline speculation, combined TP/PP, DP/CP, wider/asymmetric speculative topologies or other target identities.
Transport evidence is TCP only. Cross-node RDMA, production SpecForge Catalog/consumer retention and workload performance acceptance remain open.

summary.scope: Counts exclude seed snapshots, ordinary distributed snapshots and unit fixtures unless explicitly named.

checks.ruff: Repository F401,F821,UP037 on all 15 changed Python files; broader rules with I001 excluded on PD helpers/new runtime tests.
